name: ACCEPTABLE USE POLICY
meta_description: Standards of conduct, system boundaries, and operational integrity across the LAMID ONE platform.
title: Acceptable Use Policy
description: Standards governing platform conduct, system security, and integrity across all LAMID ONE workspaces.

paragraphs.text: This Policy sets the mandatory operating standards, security expectations, and ethical conduct required of all platform participants.
Users may not engage in unlawful activity, security boundary probing, escrow fraud, unauthorized access attempts, or malicious interference with infrastructure, payments, or third-party integrations.
• Escrow Integrity: Manipulation of deliverable verification criteria, collusion, or bad-faith dispute filing is strictly prohibited and subject to immediate suspension.

Decision engines and automated workflows must be operated in compliance with applicable law and professional fiduciary duties. Users may not weaponize automated tools, forge project deliverables, or attempt to circumvent safety or access gates.
• Rate and Resource Limits: Automated scripts and high-frequency queries must honor published API velocity constraints.

Members must access organizational workspaces strictly within their authorized mandate. Sharing master credentials, exfiltrating proprietary documents without permission, or impersonating executive sponsors violates platform policy.
• Immediate Enforcement: Violations trigger immediate access revocation and administrative audit review.
